verdict.rationale: Daytona documents official TypeScript and Python SDKs for working with sandboxes programmatically, gives a concrete Python SDK code example, and its agent-skill page also references Go and Ruby SDKs. A published OpenAPI spec backs the API surface. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage, in-depth evidence for the Go and Ruby SDKs beyond a single mention

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Daytona TypeScript SDK provides a powerful interface for programmatically interacting with Daytona Sandboxes.
The Daytona Python SDK provides a robust interface for programmatically interacting with Daytona Sandboxes.
Includes references and practical patterns for the Daytona API, CLI, Python, TypeScript, Go, and Ruby SDKs.
